note: Actual shipments exist and are documented, but the direction is predominantly INBOUND: the free ImportKey view shows 434 customs records, latest 2026-02-04, with Indian import rows from Chinese suppliers (Zhejiang Acme Power, Lishui Yekai, Jinhua Hairun, Zhejiang Careyou) into Tuglakabad ICD / Patparganj ICD, HS 8467.91.00 and 8467.99.00 (parts for brush cutters/chainsaws). Outbound trade is evidenced only at aggregate level: the same page lists this company as supplier to NMD Trading Co. Ltd (Bangkok, Thailand, 29+4 shipments), OOO "Status Pro" (Russia, 18) and To Winzor Bel LLC (Minsk, Belarus, 2). No individual export record with date, destination HS code and bill-of-lading number was visible on the free tier — volza, eximpedia and trademo all returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so the export rows could not be opened. Export status is therefore set to confirmed on the strength of named foreign buyers with shipment counts, but the per-shipment B/L and HS detail is NOT public on free sources and is recorded as null rather than invented. HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 820240 (hand saws / saw blades) does not match the observed trade, which is 8467.91.00 and 8467.99.00 (parts of chainsaws and brush cutters) plus finished garden machinery. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to 8467.91 / 8467.99. Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is also wrong: the actual profile is agricultural/garden machinery and spare parts trading. Role: trader/importer-distributor (imports Chinese OEM parts, re-exports to Thailand, Russia, Belarus) — not a manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null, not public. No GSTIN, CIN or PAN was visible in the sources read, so those fields are left empty rather than guessed.
